sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Use the main window to review local cluster status and open focused tools.

sections.title: Nodes
sections.body: This preview validates node records from the local config.json file at startup. The packaged Settings surface is currently read-only. Use Quit from the notification-area tray icon (the window close button only hides RCM), then rerun it with --configure to change supported local fields. Keep real topology out of source control.

sections.title: Remote Desktop
sections.body: Remote Desktop uses an opaque stored credential reference. This application never asks for or displays a remote password.

sections.title: Cleanup
sections.body: Cleanup acts only on locally scanned, identity-bound candidates. Review the selection before applying it.

sections.title: Hide and exit
sections.body: Closing the main window hides it. Use Show to restore it or Quit for bounded graceful shutdown.

sections.title: Preview limits
sections.body: The current packaged preview demonstrates the desktop and validated local configuration foundation. Service buttons that report unavailable are not configured in this build; it is not a fleet agent or a replacement for an existing 1.x deployment.
